resources.string: Offline • No account • No ads\nAliases and handwriting stay on this device. No cloud backup. Uninstalling removes saved profiles and examples.

JellyBolt Games stores your chosen profile aliases and labeled drawings in this app’s private storage. A child’s real name is not required. Nothing is sent to us: no accounts, internet permission, advertising, analytics, tracking, synchronization, or cloud backup.

Examples are saved only when you choose to save them. You can undo an example or delete a profile. Uninstalling or clearing app data removes all profiles, with no in-app recovery. Android protects the private storage; this app does not add database encryption.

The optional system keyboard inserts your chosen input into the active app, but does not record or upload ordinary keystrokes, editor contents, or passwords. Backspace may briefly read the selection or immediately preceding character to delete it safely; it is not retained. Keyboard learning is opt-in and disabled for Android-marked password fields and private-input requests. You enable or disable the keyboard in Android settings.

Confirmed practice output is a draft. Copying uses the device clipboard. Other apps have their own privacy policies for text you insert or paste. This is an assistive prototype, not a diagnostic or treatment tool. Contact: jellybolt@sharebot.net. Avoid emailing a child’s drawings, full name, or medical information.
Choose or add a local profile
Use an alias, not a full name. Each profile learns separately. Creating a profile starts a fresh drawing and output.
Switch to “%1$s”? The current drawing and output will be cleared. Saved examples remain with their original profile.
Permanently delete “%1$s” and all of their saved handwriting examples? The current drawing and output will also be cleared. This cannot be undone.
Add a child profile first. No real name is needed.
Local profile created. You can train or confirm a character manually.
Profile switched. The drawing and suggestions were cleared.
Profile and its saved examples deleted from this device.
Character group changed. Draw a new character.

An adult chooses the intended character. Draw the whole character, including every stroke, then tap Save labeled example. Irregular or mirrored forms are welcome: label the character the child intended.

Draw one character, or enable whole-word mode to draw a separated word or number. Pause after lifting your finger to insert the prediction. A new stroke resets the pause. You can turn automatic insertion off and use Recognize and Confirm instead.
Which character is the child drawing?

Aim for 20–50 varied examples per character over time. This is a guide, not a minimum: every saved example counts. Train several different characters. Suggestions may still be wrong; there is no accuracy promise.
Saved examples for “%1$s”: %2$d • Different characters trained in this group: %3$d
Example count unavailable. See the error message; saved data has not been reset.
Undo latest example for this character
Remove the most recently saved example labeled “%1$s” from this profile?
Saved an example of “%1$s”. Draw another when ready.
There is no saved example for “%1$s” to undo.
Draw one character with a finger or stylus. Lift between strokes. In writing mode, a pause can automatically insert the prediction. In teaching mode, choose Save labeled example.
Lift between strokes. Writing mode can insert after a pause; increase the pause or turn it off if you need more time. Teaching mode waits for Save.
Drawing cleared. Confirmed output is unchanged.
Draw one complete character first, or choose a character manually.
Finish the current stroke before continuing.
This drawing has reached its size limit. The unfinished stroke was discarded. Undo a stroke or clear the drawing before continuing.
Comparing starter shapes and your personal examples…
Match similarity is a shape-comparison score, NOT statistical accuracy, probability, or confidence. Automatic mode inserts the best match even if uncertain; check it and correct mistakes.
No current suggestions. Draw and recognize, or choose a character manually.
Built-in starter shapes are available before training. Add personal examples to improve your matches.
The matches are uncertain. Please choose the intended character or correct it manually.
Review these possible matches, choose the intended character, then confirm it.
Also save this drawing as an example of the chosen character (adult choice)
Choose the intended character before confirming.
To learn from this correction, draw a character first. Otherwise turn off the save-example checkbox.
Confirmed “%1$s”. Ready for the next character.
Confirmed “%1$s” and saved its drawing to this profile.

Characters are appended in logical typing order, automatically after a pause or by manual confirmation. Undo removes the last character. Select text to copy, or use Copy output. This is a draft, not a saved document.
Clear the entire confirmed output? Your saved handwriting examples will not be deleted.
Output copied to the device clipboard. Other apps may read text you paste.
There is no confirmed output yet.
The output draft is full (4,096 characters). Copy it before clearing or removing characters.
Choose teaching or writing. Automatic writing can be turned off or slowed down.
Activity changed. Suggestions were cleared; the current drawing is still available.

This action could not be completed using the local data. Check that the device has free storage space and try again. If the problem continues, keep the app installed so its saved examples are preserved. Data has not been automatically reset.
That alias is already in use. Choose a different alias for the new profile.
This character already has 200 saved examples. Undo an example for this character before saving another. The current drawing and output have not been changed.
This device already has 20 profiles. Switch to an existing profile, or delete a profile only if its saved examples are no longer needed.
The saved drawing draft could not be restored. Saved training examples were not changed.
